spec.structural_change: DRIVE-S81-CAP 10-20 s81sl_capc5l = capc5j + post_cts REFINE (rt_leaf_balance.tcl ot_rtb_refine): the 5i/5j gates (GRT0, cw/ce 30-43 in 5j) failed only rt pair TT 86.2/FF 84.5 because DPL + hold repair after the in-CTS balance moved the soft region (512..536 -> 470..497) while the u_rt chain did not follow (u_rt 493..556); refine after repair removes/adds u_rt chain stages to the soft centre, legalises and re-measures (offline replay on the 5i db: pair 86.1 -> 48.7 TT). DRIVE-S81-CAP 10-20 s81sl_capc5l (parallel variant of 5i): the same post-CTS region latency balance applied to ALL FIVE regions (rt with u_rt; cw with u_ld3/u_tw; ce with u_ed/u_te; rn; rs), because cw/ce passed with only 3-4 ps margin (76.8/76.3 TT). Offline replay on the capc5e CTS db: pairs rt 50, cw 33, ce 33; rn/rs spread 25/24. Same GRT dont_touch fix, RTL, regions, landings, cycles. S81-TILES-B 10-20 VARIANT E = capc5c with the ck_rt entry moved from the S face (x185) to the W face at y95-97, in the W channel beside u_rt between the two rt register bands (S band y~10-40 under u_rt, N band y~150-200 above it): capc5c/5d gates FAILED ck_rt TT 131/FF 108 pin-flop spread because the S-face entry reached the N band only around the 250-um-wide u_rt. Same RTL (ot_s81sl_capc5c), regions, children, landings. S81-CAPC5 10-20 VARIANT C of the LANDED capc parent (tools/landed_parent/specs/ot_s81sl_capc5c.json from flat ot_s81sl_capc5cf): capc5b gate 03:2x FAILED clock with cw 49/49 PASS but core 134/120 and rt 178/150 (a region holding a hard child or u_rt together with a full face of pin registers gets ~100+ ps TritonCTS soft spread). C = 5 LOCAL regions: rt (u_rt + landing rings only), cw (W face regs + u_ld3 + u_tw, as B PASS), ce (E face regs + u_te + u_ed), rn (N face: cfg in-regs + N out-regs), rs (S face out-regs + fault). Every u_rt output face is now LANDED into its own face region (S +3 vs capc5b: all outputs W+8 = +6 vs capc2; inputs unchanged). rt reset loads 45 -> lp regional_reset_copies (2 kept copies, same reset age, no added edge). n32 ring writer kept (native32).
